ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.label: mech yard
ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.leavesWhy: the Lattice takes its tents and its mechs, and leaves the rock its mechs cut

texts.li: A mech-tender and two link-hands of {FACTION} are walking in with their labour mechs behind them, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will keep a mech yard by the colony for some days.

[lowtech] Three of {FACTION} in indigo robes are walking in, {X_nameDef} at the front, with a few working mechs plodding behind them. They will camp by the colony for some days, their mechs cutting rock.

settled.li: {FACTION}'s mech yard is set up {PLACE}: tents in a row, a fire, and the mechs standing ready beside a cleared patch for the rock they cut.
The Lattice's yard is set up {PLACE}, the mechs lined up by the fire and the link-hands checking each of them over.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, a link-hand at the mech yard {PLACE}, asks whether the colony would take {X_objective} in. {X_pronoun} has kept other people's mechs running for years and would like to stay in one place.

farewell.li: [feral,cut] The mech yard packed up and walked off, one mech fewer than came. They left the {CUT} loads of rock their mechs cut piled by their old camp, for the colony to use.
[hired,cut] The mech yard packed up and walked off with its mechs. The colony had their mechs' work for a day, and they left the {CUT} loads of rock they cut piled by their old camp.
[cut] The mech yard packed up and walked off with its mechs, leaving the {CUT} loads of rock they cut piled by their old camp for the colony.
[feral] The mech yard packed up and walked off, one mech fewer than came.
The mech yard packed up its tents and walked off with its mechs.

lines.li: Check the joints before the next shift.
That one needs a new actuator soon.
Keep the mechs clear of the colony's fields.

momentLines.li: [feral] It's slipped its link, everyone keep back.
[band] They're here for the mechs, get them behind the fire.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat with the link-hands by their fire and heard how the first Lattice was linked on a battlefield where a hundred mechs stood still.

li.label: Hire their mechs for a day
li.tip: For a day the yard's lifters carry the colony's loose things into its stockpiles, and the rest mend its worn buildings.

outcomes.li: The silver is carried over, and the yard's mechs start on the colony's work.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to see to their hurt
li.tip: The colony's doctor goes over to the mech yard and tends whoever of them is hurt, with the colony's medicine where there is any.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the mech yard to see to their hurt.

ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.label: listening ring
ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.leavesWhy: the Choir leaves nothing behind them where they sat

texts.li: A few of {FACTION} in pale robes are walking in, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will sit in a ring at the quietest place on the colony's land for some days and sing each evening.
[lowtech] A few of {FACTION}, barefoot and in pale robes, are walking in, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will camp some days at the quietest place on the colony's land and sing there each evening.

settled.li: {FACTION}'s listening ring is set up {PLACE}, away from the colony's workshops: bedrolls in a ring round one small fire.
The Choir has settled {PLACE}, in a ring round their fire, and they are quiet.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, one of the Choir camped {PLACE}, asks whether {X_pronoun} might stay with the colony a while longer than the others, to learn what an ordinary life is like.

farewell.li: [strange] The listening ring packed up early and left in silence. Their last evening's song had gone strange, and they would not stay with the void so close.
[quiet,sang] The listening ring packed up and left after {NIGHTS} evenings of singing, glad of the quiet the colony kept for them.
[sang] The listening ring packed up and left after {NIGHTS} evenings of singing.
The listening ring packed up and left as quietly as it came.

lines.li: It's very quiet here, which is good.

momentLines.li: [song] We'll start, and they'll hear it in the colony tonight.
[loud] There's loud work near us tonight, it carries.
[strange] The song came out wrong tonight, we're leaving.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat a while at the Choir's fire and heard how Ilsabet Ruen lay down at the foot of the Spire and woke able to hear it think.

li.label: Send a psycaster of the colony's to sit with them
li.tip: The colony's psycaster with the least focus left goes to the ring and sits with them a couple of hours, and comes back with their focus full.

outcomes.li: A psycaster of the colony's is going over to sit with the ring.

li.label: Keep loud work away from them at night
li.tip: The colony promises to keep mining, building and taking down away from the ring at night.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the Choir's ring. The colony's work carries at night, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether the colony would keep loud work, mining, building or taking down, away from the ring after dark.

li.refuseLabel: The work has to go on

refused.li: {X_nameDef} nods and goes back to the ring.

outcomes.li: The colony will keep its loud work away from the ring at night.

ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.label: surface scouts
ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.leavesWhy: the scouts number off and take everything back down with them

texts.li: Three surface-scouts of {FACTION} are walking in, {X_nameDef} at the front, looking up at the sky more than at the path. They will camp by the colony for a week to learn the surface.
[lowtech] Three of {FACTION}'s scouts are walking in with packs and capes over their vault suits, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will camp by the colony for a week to learn how people live up here.

settled.li: {FACTION}'s surface scouts have made camp {PLACE}: three tents in a neat row and a fire, with the vault's number painted on each tent.
The vault's scouts are set up {PLACE}, and they have numbered off twice already.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, one of the vault's scouts camped {PLACE}, asks whether {X_pronoun} could stay with the colony instead of going back below. {X_pronoun} has got used to the sky, {X_pronoun} says, and would rather not lose it again.

farewell.li: [taught,mauled] The surface scouts numbered off and walked home after {LESSONS} afternoons of lessons, one of them still bandaged from the beast that turned on them.
[taught,found] The surface scouts numbered off and walked home after {LESSONS} afternoons of lessons, all three of them, thanks to the colony's search.
[taught] The surface scouts numbered off and walked home to the vault after {LESSONS} afternoons of lessons, taking what they learned with them.
[mauled] The surface scouts numbered off and walked home, one of them still bandaged from the beast that turned on them.
The surface scouts numbered off and walked home to the vault.

lines.li: There's nothing over us out here.
Is that weather, or is something wrong?
The overseer will want to hear about this.

momentLines.li: [skysick] I can't go out there today, the sky is too big.
[out] All right, I'll come out, but stay with me.
[learned] We'll take that back down and teach the others.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat with the scouts by their fire and heard how Overseer Hollis Crane broke the vault's seal and walked out first, and how half of them went back below for a week.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to teach them about plants this afternoon
li.tip: {A_nameDef}, the colony's best grower, goes to the scouts' fire and teaches them two hours about plants. They learn it, and the vault remembers it.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the scouts' camp. Down in the vault nothing grew that wasn't in a tray, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether {A_nameDef} would teach them about plants this afternoon.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} goes back to the camp to wait for tomorrow.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the scouts' fire to teach them about plants.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to teach them about animals this afternoon
li.tip: {A_nameDef}, the colony's best with animals, goes to the scouts' fire and teaches them two hours about animals. They learn it, and the vault remembers it.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the scouts' camp. They don't know which animals up here are safe, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether {A_nameDef} would teach them about animals this afternoon.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} goes back to the camp to wait for tomorrow.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the scouts' fire to teach them about animals.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to teach them to shoot this afternoon
li.tip: {A_nameDef}, the colony's best shot, goes to the scouts' fire and teaches them two hours of shooting. They learn it, and the vault remembers it.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the scouts' camp. The vault's security used to do all the shooting, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether {A_nameDef} would teach them this afternoon.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} goes back to the camp to wait for tomorrow.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the scouts' fire to teach them to shoot.

li.label: Buy their last odds and ends
li.tip: The scouts set out the last things they brought up from the vault at their fire, for the colony's silver.

outcomes.li: The silver is carried over, and the scouts set their last odds and ends out by their fire.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to talk the scout out of the tent
li.tip: {A_nameDef} goes to the scouts' camp and talks an hour with the one who won't come out, until they do.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the scouts' camp. One of them woke up afraid of the sky and won't come out of the tent, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether {A_nameDef} would come and talk to them.

li.refuseLabel: They'll come out when they're ready

refused.li: {X_nameDef} goes back to sit by the tent.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the scouts' camp to talk to the one in the tent.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} out to look for the lost scout
li.tip: {A_nameDef} goes out on the land to where the scout is and walks them back to the camp.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the scouts' camp in the dark. One of them went out at dusk to look at the land and hasn't come back, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether {A_nameDef} would go out and look.

li.refuseLabel: They'll find their way at first light

refused.li: {X_nameDef} goes back to the camp to keep the fire high.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going out on the land to look for the lost scout.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to see to their hurt
li.tip: The colony's doctor goes over to the scouts' camp and tends whoever of them is hurt, with the colony's medicine where there is any.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the scouts' camp to see to their hurt.
